newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-SANTOS GAIN REVENGE FOR FLOUDERING FISH CELEBRATIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SANTOS GAIN REVENGE FOR FLOUDERING FISH CELEBRATIONS.

text.p: Santos, whose players were infuriated by their rivals' goal celebrations when they lost 3-1 to Corinthians last month, gained ample revenge at the weekend by beating same team 2-0.
Santos, nicknamed "The Fish" because they come from a port city, were out for revenge after what they saw as unsporting behaviour by the Corinthians players in the previous meeting.

On that occasion, Corinthians players had celebrated one goal by falling to the ground and imitating a fish floundering on the sand and another goal by mimicking a fisherman dangling his catch from his rod.
A series of crunching tackles underlined the bad feeling between the players as Santos had the last laugh in the Sao Paulo championship game.

Midfielder Caico put Santos ahead with a spectacular first-half strike while former Brazil international Muller scored with a sweetly-hit volley in injury time to claim his first goal since joining the club last month.
For the last 20 minutes, Muller, who is at his fourth club in less than one year, was partnered in attack by 36-year-old former Brazil international Careca.
Corinthians' misery was complete when they had two players sent off in the last quarter of an hour.
Goalkeeper Ronaldo was shown the red card for swearing at the referee and forward Donizete followed for a second bookable offence.
The game was marred when a radio reporter behind one of the goals needed medical treatment after being struck by a firecracker thrown from the crowd.
Fans also hurled cups of water and flip-flops onto the field during the game, despite an appeal from Santos captain Ronaldao for them to stop.

Santos went level on points with second-placed Portuguesa, held 1-1 by Internacional Limeira, in group one. Both teams are two points behind leaders Palmeiras, whose advantage was cut by a 3-1 at home to Uniao Sao Joao.
Corinthians, who lead group two, have already made sure of a place in the four-team final round, along with Sao Paulo, who are second.
The top two teams in each group qualify for the final round. At this stage of the competition, teams play matches against sides from the opposite group.
